What happens after a storm hits.

Step 1

Stop the water.

After a Kansas City storm we tarp first, so nothing else gets wet. Emergency tarping is available.

Step 2

Inspect and photograph.

The inspection is free. We get on the roof, photograph every hit, and tell you plainly what needs work. Wind-lifted shingles often look fine from the ground, so we check the whole roof.

Step 3

Meet your adjuster.

We handle your claim from first inspection to final payment, meet the adjuster on site and document every damaged area. We work with every major carrier.

Step 4

Restore it properly.

Repair or full replacement, with a written warranty and a clean site. Storm-damaged siding often falls under the same claim, so we inspect both together.

Everything on the outside of your home.

Missing shingles, failed flashing, valleys, pipe boots and small leaks. We fix the actual cause instead of patching over it, and we’ll tell you honestly if a repair makes more sense than a replacement. Same-week scheduling across the Kansas City metro.

Hail and wind take a roof apart faster than you can see from the ground. We inspect free, photograph the damage, and restore your roof to better than it was before the storm. Emergency tarping available.

When a roof is past repairing we tear off to the deck, replace damaged wood and install a full new system with proper underlayment and ventilation. Architectural and three-tab shingle, metal and flat systems, with a written warranty.

Repair and full replacement in vinyl, James Hardie fiber cement and wood. Fiber cement stands up to Kansas City hail, wind and temperature swings far better than vinyl. Free estimate and color consultation.

Energy-efficient replacement windows, fitted properly and sealed right. Whole-house replacements or a single problem window. Free measure and quote.

Coatings that seal and extend the life of flat and low-slope roofs, often at a fraction of replacement cost. We assess the existing membrane, repair the failures first, then coat. Free commercial roof assessment.
